featured_reviews.name: Pradeep Thathanath
featured_reviews.review_text:
Had a great experience at Desi Savory tiffin House. The food was fresh, flavorful, and authentically desi—every dish was well prepared and nicely presented. The quality and taste really stand out.

The service deserves special mention: the staff were polite, especially archana sing who treated like their home guest. and quick to respond, making the overall dining experience very comfortable and pleasant.

Highly recommended for anyone looking for good desi food with excellent service. Will definitely visit again!

featured_reviews.name: Anil Yadav
featured_reviews.review_text:
I recently had the pleasure of visiting Desi Savory Restaurant in Bhayandar East, and I must say it was an excellent experience! I ordered their Aloo Paratha, and it was one of the best I’ve had in a long time. The paratha was soft, fresh, and perfectly stuffed with flavorful potato filling — crispy on the outside and full of authentic taste inside. It was served with curd, butter, and pickle, which made it even more delicious.

The service was quick and very polite — the staff made sure everything was served hot and on time. The restaurant has a clean, homely environment and gives a true desi food feeling. The quality of food and hygiene was impressive, and the prices were also very reasonable for the taste and portion size.

I really appreciate how they maintain both taste and presentation. It’s clear that they care about customer satisfaction.

If you’re in Bhayandar and craving good desi-style food or want a proper homemade meal experience, Desi Savory Restaurant is the place to go! I’ll definitely come back again to try their paneer dishes, thalis, and tiffin service.

Highly recommended for families, office-goers, and anyone who enjoys authentic Indian flavors.

featured_reviews.name: sunil jaiswal
featured_reviews.review_text:

The staff was very polite and friendly, and the service was quick. The restaurant is clean, comfortable, and gives proper desi vibes. It’s a great place for anyone who loves North Indian or homestyle food.

Highly recommended! I’ll definitely visit again to try their other items like paneer paratha and tiffin meals. 👍

Over the past month,  had the opportunity to prepare and serve several group meal orders for family gatherings, small celebrations, community occasions, and important personal events with most orders serving around 20-30 people.

One thing we truly realised during these preparations was how efficiently a well-planned, simple menu can be prepared fresh within a short timeframe. In many cases, our kitchen was able to prepare wholesome vegetarian meals for 15-20 people in approximately 2 hours while maintaining consistency, freshness, and homely taste.

Over time, many families have also trusted us for meals prepared during sensitive occasions and post-ritual gatherings. We understand that during such moments, food is not just about serving people, it is about providing comfort, reliability, and support with care and respect.

Whether it is a small house gathering, festive celebration, office meal, community event, sudden requirement, or thoughtfully prepared condolence meals, our kitchen is always ready to help with fresh vegetarian food prepared sincerely and responsibly.

📍 Serving Mira Road & Bhayandar
💬 Bulk meal and catering enquiries are welcome.

A small milestone for our kitchen 🚂✨✨

Over time, it has been encouraging to see more people discovering our home-style meals through platforms like Zomato. From everyday tiffins and veg thalis to seasonal specials and catering preparations, the support has truly meant a lot to us.

We’re also happy to share that  is gradually preparing to become available on more food delivery platforms soon, making it easier for nearby customers in Mira Road & Bhayandar to explore our vegetarian meals and home-style food offerings.

Our focus continues to remain the same fresh preparation, comforting flavours, and thoughtfully cooked food.

📍 Serving Mira Road & Bhayandar

Ongoing Faral Preparations for Navratri

These past few days have been truly special in our kitchen. With the festive season in full swing, we’ve been preparing and sending out different varieties of Faral quickly so everyone can enjoy their fasting meals without the stress of cooking every day.

From simple favourites to comforting festive bites, it’s been amazing to see how much people are enjoying these preparations.

At Gujju Junction, we’re continuing to prepare fresh Faral varieties throughout Navratri for those observing the festival.

📍 Serving Mira Road & Bhayandar

During Paryushan, we truly realised the beauty of Jain cooking. 

With so many ingredients avoided, the kitchen becomes a place of creativity, patience, and respect for tradition. Yet somehow, the meals still feel complete, comforting, and full of flavour.

That experience reminded us that food doesn't need excess sometimes simplicity creates the most meaningful feasts.

At Gujju Junction, we’re always happy to prepare thoughtful Jain meals, thalis, and catering for those who prefer this style of cooking.

featured_reviews.name: prashant vasudev
featured_reviews.review_text:
A Good Home based tiffin service for Lunch and Dinner with a wide range of dishes .
Very good in taste + Less Oily .
Takeaway and delivery both options available .
Preferred timings for ordering Lunch is 9 am and dinner 5 pm .
I frequently order Lunch/Dinner which costs around 130 rs for takeaway and if delivery is required than 45 rs delivery charges .
(Regular tiffin has Dal, rice , salad , papad , 1 sabji and 5 roti )
Hoping they start the Weekly/monthly Subscriptions/Discounts for regular customer's.
Food is hygienically cooked and properly packed 👍
Quantity and Quality both 👌
Sometimes they have special menu's/Offers during weekend/Festival's.

featured_reviews.name: Dhiren Thaker
featured_reviews.review_text:
We have been frequently using this tiffin service, and it has consistently exceeded our expectations. The food is delicious, fresh, and truly reminds us of home — just like a mother’s cooking. Every meal is satisfying and prepared with care.

The service and delivery are always prompt and reliable. One of the things we really appreciate is how humble and polite they are during phone conversations — it adds a personal and warm touch to the overall experience.

It’s also very budget-friendly, making it an ideal choice for regular meals without compromising on quality or taste. Highly recommended for anyone looking for homely, affordable, and well-managed tiffin service.
